app_store.name: ServiceFinder: Home Services
app_store.subtitle: Verified Crews & Escrow Pay
app_store.promotional_text: Book verified multi-technician service crews with live GPS tracking, upfront pricing, and two-phase escrow protection. What you see is what you pay.
app_store.description:
ServiceFinder connects homeowners and businesses with verified local service companies.

WHAT MAKES SERVICEFINDER DIFFERENT:

1. ZERO SURPRISE FEES
See the full price breakdown upfront before booking. No unexpected service fees at checkout and no rate changes at your door.

2. CREWLOCK ESCROW PROTECTION
Your payment is held safely in escrow. Funds are only released after the job is complete, before-and-after photos are verified, and you provide a digital signature.

3. MULTI-TECHNICIAN FLEET DISPATCH
Book established local trade companies with coordinated crews, not unverified solo gig workers. If a technician is unavailable, the company automatically dispatches a qualified replacement.

4. REAL-TIME GPS TRACKING
Watch your technician arrive with turn-by-turn live navigation and verified arrival timestamps. No more waiting around all day.

5. BEFORE & AFTER PROOF OF WORK
Every milestone includes photographic documentation. Review completed work right on your phone before approving payment.

POPULAR SERVICES:
- Air conditioning repair and maintenance
- Licensed electrical inspections and wiring
- Emergency plumbing and leak repair
- Residential and commercial deep cleaning
- Handyman and appliance installation

Book your trusted service crew in minutes.
